\w[signskin]Fallarbor Town\n“A Farm Community With Small Gardens.”
\bI've seen shady characters wandering\nin and out of Prof. Cozmo's home…
\bThis region's been known for meteors\nsince the olden days.
\bThey say Meteor Falls was gouged out\nby a falling meteorite long ago.
\rSee! Take a look!\nThis is my precious Azurill!
\rIt's slick and smooth and plushy, too!
\w[signskin]Move Tutor's House\n“New moves taught to POKéMON.”
\bHave you already challenged Flannery,\nthe Leader of Lavaridge Gym?
\bThe girl's grandfather was famous.\nHe was one of the Elite Four in the\nPOKéMON League at one point.
\bIt wouldn't surprise me to see Flannery\nbecome a great Trainer in her own\nright.
\w[signskin]Battle Tent Fallarbor Site\n“May the Greatest Teams Gather!”
